name: Miyoshi (Hiroshima, Japan)
description: A red field charged at the centre with the Miyoshi city emblem in white: two stylised running figures with discs.
history: Municipal flag of Miyoshi, a city in Hiroshima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 April 2004.

features.role: Miyoshi city emblem — two stylised running figures with discs
